text:
Lina (Design): sharing current confirm modal — https://img.redwood.ai/deact-key-modal.png
Lina (Design): primary is red "Deactivate key", secondary "Cancel". wondering if Cancel is clear enough here.
Priya (Product): agree, 'Cancel' doesn't communicate what you're keeping. users might think it cancels the request vs keeps key active. Suggest 'Keep key' as secondary.
Omar (Security): also we use both 'revoke' and 'deactivate' across the product. we should standardize. Security prefers 'Revoke key' for audit clarity (sounds irreversible). anyone opposed to using 'Revoke' in the UI?
Lina (Design): good point. for tone 'Deactivate' feels softer. can we pick one and add the exact consequence in the body copy?
Alex (Accessibility): whichever verb we pick, ensure the body includes explicit state change text for screen readers: e.g., "This will revoke access for services using this key. Requests will fail immediately." And add `aria-describedby="deact-desc"` on the dialog.
Theo (Eng): implementation notes: DOM order controls tab focus. If we keep platform convention (destructive right), put [Keep key] first in DOM, [Revoke key] last. We'll also set autofocus on the secondary by default? that's risky. Better to preserve natural focus sequence.
Sam (DevEx): small product ask: the success toast/audit entry copies should match the modal. so whatever label we show -> also used in logs: e.g., "API key revoked by user X". helps support.
Nina (Localization): heads up: german and ja expanders; "Deactivate API key" -> long in ja. can we have short visible labels like "Deactivate" / "Keep" + `aria-label` with full text including key id for screen readers? i18n team can give max char counts if you want.
Priya (Product): love the short visible labels + aria-label idea. keeps UI tight on mobile. also add a tooltip on hover that shows full phrasing for mouse users.
Omar (Security): if we use 'Revoke', add a sentence about audit retention and whether this is reversible. Security requires the modal to say if the key can be restored or if rotations are preferred.
Lina (Design): proposed microcopy update: Header: "Deactivate API key?" Body: "Deactivating a key immediately prevents any service using it from authenticating. You can re-enable keys within 7 days." Primary visible: "Deactivate" aria-label: "Deactivate API key: abcd-1234" Secondary visible: "Keep" aria-label: "Keep API key: abcd-1234"
Alex (Accessibility): +1. Also ensure the dialog gets aria-modal=true and focus moves into the dialog on open. Add a recovery link in the body to the key history for screen reader users.
Theo (Eng): fine with copy. i'll wire up `aria-label` and `aria-describedby`. i'll also add a test to the component story showing the short/long variants and the toast text.
Nina (Localization): request: please put the full strings in a locale table column so i18n can run WCAG line-break tests. i'll ask L10n for max lengths for ja/de.
Sam (DevEx): one more: analytics show single-word CTAs improve click accuracy on mobile. prefer visible single words. logging will use full verbs.
Priya (Product): ok decision: visible single-word CTAs "Deactivate" / "Keep" + full accessible labels and matching audit log copy. Lina, can you update mocks and include both label variants?
Lina (Design): will do — i'll add aaccesibility notes and include copy examples for toast + audit entry: "API key abcd-1234 deactivated by @lina". will post updated Figma and link PR.
Omar (Security): also add a short sentence in the body if the key is currently used by active services (we can pull usage count): e.g., "This key is used by 3 active services."
Alex (Accessibility): and add keyboard-only acceptance tests to the PR: tab order, Enter activates primary, Escape closes, focus return to trigger. run our axe/pa11y checks and note any false positives.
Theo (Eng): i'll include unit tests for focus management and the audit message formatting. PR will reference this thread.
Priya (Product): assigning follow-ups: lina -> mock updates + strings table, theo -> component + tests, nina -> i18n charcounts, alex -> accessibility checklist, omar -> final security blurb.
Lina (Design): thanks all, i'll update and ping when the PR is up. :white_check_mark:
